camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/replaceObjectBindings --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'sourceId=exampleSourceId&objectBindings=[{graphName=string_value, objectId=exampleObjectId, objectType=string_value}]' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Replaces all object bindings for a specified data source
description_zh: 用于全量替换指定数据源下的对象绑定信息
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo replace-object-bindings --source-id exampleSourceId --object-bindings graphName=string_value objectId=exampleObjectId objectType=string_value --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceObjectBindings

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter and is explicitly passed by winnexo-cli through the --tenant-id option
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the personal FILE data source to be replaced, which is unique within the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 待替换的个人 FILE 数据源 ID（租户内唯一）
parameters.name: source_id

fields.help_en: The name of the semantic graph to which the bound object belongs. The object_id must be unique within this graph. This parameter is required
fields.help_zh: 绑定对象归属的语义图谱名（object_id 在该 graph 下唯一，必填）
fields.name: graph_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the bound object
fields.name: object_id

fields.help_en: The object type to attach, such as customer or project
fields.help_zh: 绑定对象类型（如 customer / project）
fields.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The new list of object bindings for full replacement. Passing an empty list clears all bindings
parameters.help_zh: 新的对象绑定列表（全量替换；传空列表表示清空所有绑定）
parameters.name: object_bindings

200.description_en: 全量替换数据源对象绑定
200.description_zh: 全量替换数据源对象绑定
